placements.title: Owned intelligence is the asset that persists; substrate is a commodity
placements.theme: The value worth keeping is the owned perspective built atop intelligence, not the underlying substrate, which is a replaceable, rentable commodity.
placements.why: src-2 draws the ownership distinction directly ('owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence'); src-3 supplies the mechanism of that distinction (substrate = commodity, perspective = the kept asset); src-4 explicitly names this as a standing thesis ('the individually-owned-intelligence thesis') rather than a one-time claim, which is what makes it leaf-grain under the narrative test — a subject future envelopes can keep feeding, not a fact. Both the existing strata and existing graph structure supplied for this repo are empty, and the position pass confirms this is genuinely new territory (no prior thesis node found at witness depth), so there is nothing to reuse against. No hub or strata category is named by this content itself — it states a directional claim about what constitutes durable value, not an organizational category — so under is left null rather than forcing a strata mint the content doesn't call for.
consulted: POSITIONS: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence (frame: what makes intelligence 'owned' rather than 'rented', which layer is the asset that persists)
POSITION VERDICTS: src-2/src-3/src-4 grouped as one directional claim, mint not attach
